Market today:
The market is spooked by surging bond yields and strong signals for more Fed rate hikes, driven by hot inflation. This hawkish outlook is a headwind for growth stocks, especially tech and chips, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-36.69%) and SPAL (-32.25%) are your most concerning positions. Both are leveraged ETFs showing significant losses and are flagged "SELL." Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on bond yields and any further Fed commentary. Specifically, monitor the price action around your stops for SOXL and SPAL.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions in this rising rate environment.
plays: Adjust stops on SOXL and SPAL immediately; their leveraged nature and "SELL" status demand attention, especially with margin.
Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL to reduce exposure to rate-sensitive, decaying assets given the current market sentiment.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
